answer: A new identity serves a probation of 4 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the thread queue naming the sable that holds the sponsor's bond. Therefore, each alias costs 4 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the vine record shows exactly who is still on probation. That is 19 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
